surface_audited: /platform unauthenticated sign-in surface (shell + sign-in form + voice panel)
coverage: PARTIAL - 1 of 145 routes. Authenticated approval and mission actions could not be audited because no session was obtainable.

unlabeled_authentication_fields.detail: email and password inputs both carry accessible names

live_regions.detail: platform error uses role=alert, so expiry recovery is announced

visible_focus_indicator.detail: Real keyboard Tab moved focus to the 'Ask Saathi' button, matched :focus-visible, and rendered outline: solid 2px rgb(143,180,255). 12 :focus-visible rules exist including a global :where(a,button,input,select,textarea,[tabindex]):focus-visible.
visible_focus_indicator.measurement_correction: An initial programmatic .focus() sweep reported 0 of 25 controls with a focus ring. That was a FALSE POSITIVE: programmatic focus deliberately does not match :focus-visible. The finding was retracted after keyboard verification.

reduced_motion_support.detail: prefers-reduced-motion media rules present in the stylesheet

findings.title: No skip-navigation link
findings.detail: No skip link was found on the audited surface. With 4 nav landmarks and 43 focusable controls, a keyboard or screen-reader user must traverse the full sidebar before reaching main content on every route.
findings.requirement_reference: Phase 7 lists 'skip navigation' as a required audit item
findings.rationale_not_fixed: Shell-wide layout change. Out of scope for a bounded session that could not regression-test authenticated routes.

findings.title: 32 of 49 interactive controls are below the 44x44 px touch target guideline
findings.detail: Measured at the 819 px viewport. Affects status chips, breadcrumb segments and compact shell controls.
findings.caveat: Guideline applies most strictly to touch input. True phone-viewport behaviour could not be measured (see mobile audit), so real-world severity on a phone is unconfirmed.

required_targets.no_blocker_or_critical_accessibility_def: MET - no P0 or P1 accessibility defect found on the audited surface

not_audited: Colour contrast ratios (requires pixel sampling across themes)
Colour-independent meaning of the signal-pulse status system
Dialog and menu focus management (no dialog reachable unauthenticated)
Error-to-field programmatic association on validation failures
verdict: PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS on the audited surface. Two P2 findings recorded, zero P0/P1. Coverage is explicitly incomplete and must not be read as a whole-application accessibility certification.
